contract.provides: Supplied rational J0,A,K,h and gamma satisfy 0<=J0<=(1-gamma)I, K>0, A in Q^{r x n},0<gamma<=1. For x in {-1,+1}^n, p(x) proportional exp[0.5 x^T J0 x+0.5(Ax)^T K(Ax)+h^T x]. Positive means PSD, not entrywise nonnegative; J0 need not have zero diagonal or obey a Dobrushin row-sum condition. The proposed randomized compiler outputs full-discrete TV-epsilon sampling and additive-epsilon log Z (relative partition accuracy), with preprocessing confidence 1-delta. Total rational input bits B include gamma. The recovered note's bound is [n^2{sqrt(n)+log(n/epsilon)}/epsilon]^{O(r)} poly(B,n,gamma^-1,epsilon^-1,log(1/delta)); the pasted report displays the looser n in place of sqrt(n). Polynomial-time scope requires fixed rank and inverse-polynomial residual gap. Rank reduction is charged rational linear algebra; tiny binary gamma is not free. No numerical spike/field norm or reciprocal Gaussian-cell mass appears in the claimed bound. Independent correctness and a certified full implementation are unestablished.
